title.narrative: Programa de Fortalecimiento de la Poltica y la Gestin Fiscales para la Atencin de la Crisis Sanitaria y Econmica Causada por la COVID-19 en Trinidad y Tobago
Programme to Strengthen Fiscal Policy and Management in Response to the Health and Economic Crisis Caused by COVID-19 in Trinidad and Tobago

description.narrative: El objetivo general del programa es fortalecer la eficiencia y la eficacia de la poltica fiscal y la gestin fiscal en respuesta a la crisis econmica y de salud causada por COVID-19, a travs del diseo y la implementacin de medidas polticas efectivas y fiscalmente responsables. Los objetivos especficos del programa son: (i) promover la disponibilidad y la ejecucin oportuna de recursos financieros y materiales para responder a los efectos de la crisis de salud causada por COVID-19; (ii) fortalecer el efecto anticclico de la poltica fiscal mediante la introduccin temporal de medidas para proteger los ingresos de los hogares vulnerables y aumentar la liquidez de las empresas durante la crisis sanitaria y econmica; y (iii) promover la recuperacin econmica y fiscal en el perodo posterior a la pandemia.

The general objective of the programme is to strengthen the efficiency and effectiveness of fiscal policy and fiscal management in response to the health and economic crisis caused by COVID-19, through the design and implementation of effective and fiscally responsible policy measures. The specific objectives of the programme are: (i) to promote the availability and timely execution of financial and material resources to respond to the effects of the health crisis caused by COVID-19; (ii) to strengthen the countercyclical effect of fiscal policy through the temporary introduction of measures to protect the income of vulnerable households and increase liquidity for businesses during the health and economic crisis; and (iii) to promote economic and fiscal recovery in the post-pandemic period.
